tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal ldan lha mo'i bskang gso bya tshul bsdus pa bzhugs/

na mo lo ki shwa ra ya/ rgyal kun thugs rje gcig bsdus pa/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang sprul pa'i gar/ /rgyal yum dbyangs can lha mo nyid/ /drag mo'i skur bstan de la 'dud/ /'dir lha mo'i bskang gso mdor bsdu zhig brjod pa la/ yo byad ci 'grub tshogs par byas nas/ rang nyid 'jigs byed kyi bdag bskyed rgyas bsdus gang rung sngon du btang nas/ mchod pa dang nang mchod bcu gsum ma ltar dang*/ bskang rdzas rnams ni/ bskang gso'i gzhung nas 'byung ba bzhin sngags drug dang phyag rgya drug gis byin brlab bya/ yang na/ mchod pa dang bskang rdzas rnams/ hrīḥṣ+tīḥs bsangs/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas byung ba'i thod pa so so'i nang du mchod rdzas rnams rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba mgron so'i dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag med kyi bde ba khyad par can bskyed par gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūṃ/ nas/ shap+ta dang*/ rū pa nas/ spar+sha āḥhūṃ gis byin gyis brlabs/ bskang rdzas rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig le brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i bskang rdzas mkho rgu'i yo byad sa dang bar snang nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ /oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra su ra su ra ā warta ya ā warta ya hoḥbadz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ swāhā/ zhes pa tsam lan gsum/ shin tu bsdu na/ ༈ /rang nyid 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis par/ / gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros te/ /mchod rdzas kun gyi nyes pa'i skyon sbyangs nas/ /zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum/ spyan 'dren ni/ rab 'byams rgyal ba ma'i tshigs bcad gnyis sam/ bsdu na/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis/ /byang shar mu le ting gi rgya mtsho nas/ /dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo 'khor dang bcas/ /spyan drangs mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs su gsol/

/ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ/ mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog bdug spos dang*/ /mar me dri chab zhal zas rol mo sogs/ /'dod khams dbang phyug 'khor bcas la 'bul bgyi/ /bzhes nas rnal 'byor bdag cag srung skyob mdzod/ /ma lus rgyal ba'i phrin las gcig bsdus nas/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir khro mo'i skur bstan pa/ /dpal ldan dmag dang zor gyi rgyal mo zhes/ /mtshan gsol bstan srung gtso la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thog ma med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang*/ /bla ma dpal ldan lha mo 'khor bcas kyi/ /sku gsung thugs dang 'gal bar rab spyad pa'i/ /dam tshig nyams chags thams cad so sor bshags/ /mchog gsum rten 'brel chos dbyings bden stobs dang*/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya'i byin rlabs mthus/ /phyi nang mchod spṛn sa dang bar snang gi /khyon gang lha mo 'khor bcas dgyes gyur cig /khrag gi mchod yon dbang po'i me tog dang*/ /sha chen tshil dud zhag chen sgron me dang*/ /sha rus zhal zas rkang gling rol tshogs kyis/ /lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang*/ /myur mgyogs rta mchog zhol chen g.yag rog dang*/ /lug nag spyi dkar khyung 'dra'i bya nag dang*/ /dom 'dra'i khy-i nag 'jigs pa'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /lha mo 'khor dang =/ gzhan yang 'dod yon rnam lnga rin chen bdun/ /dre'u rkyang ser be con thod khrag dang*/ /nad rkyal mtshon gru re nag gos rnams kyis/ /lha mo 'khor dang =/ khram shig sho rde rma bya'i gdugs mdzes dang*/ /thod bskam dbu rgyan mi mgo'i phreng ba sogs/ /phyag rgya rnam drug gtor chen mda' dar gyis/ /lha mo 'khor dang =/ /gling bzhi nyi zla ri rab seṅge dang*/ /sbrul chen rlung nag 'tshub ma byang dmar sogs/ /cha rkyen dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad kyis/ /lha mo 'khor dang =/ thugs dam bskang zhing nyams chags sos gyur nas/ /bar chad sel zhing dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /khyad par sha khrag 'bru bcud gtor ma'i tshogs/

/zag med ye shes bdud rtsir byin brlabs te/ /dpal ldan lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa kun/ / dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ /khyed (zlog pa'i mtshon byed/) rnams mchod cing thugs dam bskang byas pas/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag mi nor 'khor bcas kyi/ /'gal rkyen bar chad nyer 'tshe zlog pa dang*/ /mthun rkyen 'dod pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /'dod na skabs 'dir lha mo'i sngags bzlas kyang rung*/ de nas bstod pa bsdu na/ ༈ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug rgyal yum dbyangs can ma/ /drag mo'i skur bstan gdug pa tshar gcod cing*/ /rgyal ba'i bstan dang bstan 'dzin kun srung bar/ /zhal bzhes lha mo chen mo khyod la bstod/ /sngon tshe rgyal bas khyod nyid mngon sum du/ /bstan srung kun gyi gtso mor lung bstan nas/ /bstan pa gnyer gtad khas blangs mthu rtsal can/ /lha mo nag mor mtshan gsol khyod la bstod/ /de ltar mchod bstod gsol bas bdag cag gi /mi mthun gnod pa thams cad zhi ba dang*/ /'dod don kun sgrubs dus rnams thams cad du/ /bsrung dang skyob pa'i 'phrin las ma g.yel mdzod/ /sku gsum lhun grub 'phrin las mthar phyin yang*/ /zhes sogs brjod/ rten yod na/ 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ /zhes sogs dang*/ med na/ ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang*/ /zhes sogs kyis bzod gsol byed dam min yang*/ /oṃ badz+ra sa twa aḥzhes lan gsum gyi mthar/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra muḥ mgron rnams rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ /zhes dang*/ shis brjod mdor bsdus bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di ni/ dad dang rnam dpyod dang ldan pa'i os lā+au yes kyis rang gi zhal 'don ched bskul ba ltar shāka btsun bshad sgrub ming can gyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni tā yi la lung blo bzang don grub bo/ /maṅgalaṃ/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/ dpal ldan lha mo'i bskang gso bya tshul bsdus pa bzhugs/
